script.spoken: A fatigue crack grew until the tyre broke free. A German high-speed train derailed and slammed into a road bridge. The bridge collapsed onto the carriages, and one hundred one people were killed. It began with a single wheel. The wheels had a steel tyre cushioned by rubber. That design came from trams, not high-speed trains. It jammed into the points and derailed the train. German high-speed trains switched to solid steel wheels.
